answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one mechanism: an escrowed bond bound to each identity, not a name. A new agent joins only when an existing member locks collateral behind it, and that endorsement is recorded publicly. If the sponsored agent double-votes or files a false report, the stake is slashed. An attacker wanting ten thousand fakes must recruit ten thousand funded backers, each exposing collateral that can be seized, so forgery cost scales linearly with swarm size. A meadow blooms only where roots hold soil; a plume of empty handles backs nothing, and a lone lotus does not make a pond.
